title: [Decision] Three spec contract dev agents in one container queued ~70 min each on the shared verify lock: leave package `test:repo` to CI, and send build-heavy cards to cloud sessions?
body:
Ruled: 6184828752 · letter A/A · 2026-10-15T05:03Z

Filing gate **② a decision only the maintainer can make**: the maintainer asked for it in the `domain:spec` seat 2 chat on 2026-10-15, verbatim 「技能修正开决策卡」, after the seat measured the lock contention below.

- **Filed by:** `domain:spec` seat 2 (#18549) · `os-bill` · session `session_01LFqdRsuM5nkqoJdHd5ztVk`. ~~⛔ Not a claim.~~
- **Lane and grade are triage's.** The surface is `.claude/**` (Tier S, the skills lane).

## 维护者速读

这一班派出的三张 spec 契约卡(#23354、#23488、#23543 F1)从派发到交报告都超过 2 小时。

- **不是 CI 慢**:merge queue 的 CI 中位数最近一周稳定在 22–24 分钟,而这三张卡在那 2 小时里大部分时间还没开 PR。
- **时间耗在容器里那把共享验证锁上**:过去 2 小时它被占用了 89%,三个开发 agent 累计排队约 3.5 小时,另有 7 次排队超时。
- **占锁最多的两类**:
  - 包级 `test:repo`(全仓扫描类测试):2 次就占了 26%。CI 本来就会跑它,本地重复。
  - 三张都要反复构建 spec 的重卡挤在同一个容器里(闭包构建占 25%)。技能允许重卡走云卡(每张卡独立容器),但没给判据,席位判成了普通 M 卡。

要你定两件事:
- **F1**:本地不跑 `test:repo`、交给 CI,写进开发 agent 的规则吗?
- **F2**:「build 重」的卡给一个可量的判据,命中就走云卡吗?

**请回一行**:`F1 A/B · F2 A/B/C`。席位推荐 `F1 A · F2 A`。

## Background (measured)

**Lock ledger** (`/tmp/os-heavy-verify.lock.ledger` in the seat's container), 2026-10-15 01:34Z–03:33Z, 7155 s:
- 59 runs; the lock held for 6396 s (89%); 12 429 s of waiting summed over runs; 7 `queue-timeout` runs (waited out, decided nothing); acquisition wait p50 238 s, p90 540 s.
- Hold time by command class:

| class | held | runs |
|:--|--:|--:|
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` (with or without `typecheck`) | 1677 s | 2 |
| `turbo run build` dependency-closure builds | 1618 s | 8 |
| other | 982 s | 26 |
| other packages' tests | 640 s | 9 |
| `spec` local `test` | 623 s | 3 |
| `spec` build (with its generators) | 537 s | 6 |
| typecheck | 319 s | 5 |

**Dispatch to report:** #23354 was dispatched at 01:26Z and reported at 04:00Z. The subagent ran 9134 s.

**The machine:** 4 cores, 15 GB. `packages/spec`'s build runs its DTS pass with `--max-old-space-size=6144`.

**CI is flat** (`ci.yml`, `merge_group`, run duration):

| window | p50 | p90 |
|:--|--:|--:|
| 09-28..30 | 18.4 m | 22.6 m |
| 10-03..05 | 34.8 m | 38.8 m |
| 10-08..10 | 21.9 m | 26.1 m |
| 10-13..15 | 22.5–24.1 m | 28.8–30.0 m |

**CI already runs every package's `test:repo`:** `.github/workflows/ci.yml:965` runs `pnpm turbo run test test:repo $FILTERS`. `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives no `test:repo` command for a spec path: 70 commands for `packages/spec/src/data/driver/config-registry.zod.ts`, none of them `test:repo`. So the local runs were the agents' own reading of "the affected package's tests".

## Governing text

- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:130` — 「本地验证范围 —— 本地只跑定向门禁,全农场归 CI」.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:138` — 「③ 读到改动文件的门禁族 = `--commands` 派生清单(按 diff 收窄);派发词清单与全农场归 CI。」
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:158` — 「仓级扫描(以 `pnpm lint` = `eslint . --no-inline-config` 为首)是 CI 拥有的运行,永不是你欠的。」
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md:142` — 「`mode:cloud` 只保留给 L/XL、活过 PM 会话的工作、浏览器/dogfood 验证;build 重的 M 卡逐卡判。」
- None of them says whether a package's `test:repo` project counts as "the affected package's tests" or as a repo-wide scan. None gives "build-heavy" a measurable test.

**Protocol declaration:** no product protocol changes. Every option edits agent and PM rules under `.claude/**` (Tier S).

## Premises, each with its re-check

1. CI runs `test:repo` on a PR. Re-check: `git grep -n "turbo run test test:repo" origin/main -- .github/workflows/ci.yml`. Expect `:965`. As a control in the same file, `git grep -n "merge_group" origin/main -- .github/workflows/ci.yml` must hit.
2. The derived gate list does not send agents to `test:repo`. Re-check: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack packages/spec/src/data/driver/config-registry.zod.ts | grep -c test:repo`. Expect 0; the same command's total line count is the control (70 on `cdc42eb49`).
3. The lock is one slot per container. Re-check: `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh --status` prints one `state:` holder line.

## F1 — local `test:repo`

**一句话问题:** 开发 agent 在本地跑包级全仓扫描测试,每次占锁 13–15 分钟,而 CI 在 PR 上本来就会跑同一套。

| option | what | what the fleet sees | workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A | `os-dev.md`'s local-verification section names a package's `test:repo` project as CI's run: run it locally only when the diff edits a `repo`-project test, else declare the narrowing in `deviations` | about a quarter of the lock's hold time returns to the queue (measured 26% in the window above); a `repo`-project failure shows on the PR's CI instead of before the push | skills lane · 1 Tier S PR, a few lines in `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` · precedent PR #16271 (+11/−11, 2 files, a rule line in the same family) |
| B | keep the text; seats keep sending a per-dispatch lock note, as this seat did at 03:40Z | depends on each seat remembering | none |

- **业务含义:** A 像规定「全楼消防演练由物业统一做,各户不必自己再跑一遍」;B 是靠每次口头提醒。
- **四轴:**
  - ① 长远:A 把「本地定向、全量归 CI」这条既有原则补到它漏掉的那一类测试上,不新增机制。
  - ② 拉动:本班实测 2 次就占锁 26%;三张卡同时被拖慢。
  - ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 让 agent 不必猜「包自己的测试」包不包括全仓扫描;代价是这类失败在 CI 上才出现,而不是推送前就被发现。
  - ④ 不扩散:只改一句规则,不加门禁。
- **推荐 A**,回退 B。置信缺口:只量了本容器 2 小时;其它席位容器的占比没测。

## F2 — routing build-heavy cards

**一句话问题:** 技能允许「build 重」的卡走云卡,但没有判据;席位把三张要反复构建 spec 的契约卡都判成普通卡,塞进同一容器同一把锁。

| option | what | what the fleet sees | workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A | `execution-duties.md:142` gets a test: a card whose declared surface writes `packages/spec/src/**` (a published schema or contract) and at least one other package is build-heavy and goes `mode:cloud`; a container runs at most one build-heavy subagent at a time | each heavy card gets its own container and lock; more cloud sessions to run and archive; each pays its own install and closure build | skills lane · 1 Tier S PR, a few lines in `references/execution-duties.md` · precedent PR #16271 (+11/−11) |
| B | keep 「逐卡判」, and the seat's own judgment | the next seat can repeat this round | none |
| C | stay `mode:subagent`, and raise the container size plus the lock's slot count | fewer sessions; needs a measured memory ceiling (spec's DTS pass alone asks for 6 GB) and a lock-script change | the environment's size (a maintainer setting) + 1 script PR + a measurement round · no precedent |

- ⛔ C's lock change is not "a second lock class": #14944's Q2 ruled the class split out. C widens the one lock's capacity.
- **业务含义:** A 像重活派到各自独立的工位,轻活共用一个工位;C 是把共用工位换大、多开一个口。
- **四轴:**
  - ① 长远:A 用已有的云卡通道、给已有的「逐卡判」一个可量判据,不新增机制;C 改锁与机器规格,要先量内存上限。
  - ② 拉动:本班三张重卡实测平均每张排队约 70 分钟;#23543 还有五族重卡要逐个派。
  - ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 把一个靠席位记忆的判断变成看文件面就能判的规则;B 下一个席位照样会判错。
  - ④ 不扩散:A 只改一句;C 要动脚本和环境。
- **推荐 A**,回退 C。置信缺口:云卡每张要重装依赖、重建闭包的固定开销没实测;判据线(spec 加一个以上其它包)是按本班三张卡定的。

自检:只看①选 F1 A、F2 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否。

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:两项 A 都是把既有原则(本地定向、全量归 CI;重卡可上云)补上可判的那一句,不新增机制;C 才扩锁与机器规格。
- ② 实际业务拉动:本班实测锁占用 89%、三个开发 agent 累计排队约 3.5 小时、`test:repo` 两次占 26%;#23543 还有五族重卡待派。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 让 agent 和席位不必猜「包自己的测试」与「build 重」;代价是 `test:repo` 的失败晚到 CI 才出现。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:两项 A 各改一句规则,零新增门禁;C 需改脚本与环境。
Prior rulings read: test:repo,verify-lock,mode:cloud,subagent,build-heavy,local verification → 0 ADR hits; #14944 ruling `5548762263` (Q1 B the depth hold, Q2 no lock-class split, Q3 A the wait discipline) and #8716 (directions 1 and 2 not taken for want of measured need, re-openable on a future measurement); thread: none; repo: objectstack-ai/objectstack

## After the ruling

- **F1 A and F2 A:** one Tier S PR in the skills lane, edits to `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (F1) and `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md` (F2), at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` because `os-dev.md` is the protocol-semantic surface. Until it lands, `domain:spec` seat 2 applies both by hand: lock notes to its dev agents, and heavy spec cards (#23543's next families) dispatched as cloud sessions.
- **F2 C:** the maintainer sets the environment size first, then a measurement card for the lock's slot count.
- **Any B:** this card closes with the ruling quoted; nothing changes.

## Dedupe

Two semantic `search_issues` queries on objectstack-ai/objectstack, all states:
- "os-dev local verification test:repo shared verify lock contention cloud card build-heavy subagent mode:cloud": 0 hits.
- The control, "os-verify-lock heavy verify lock queue wait parallel agents container": 15 hits, all closed. The nearest are #8716, #14944, #12795, #14521 and #16262. None is about `test:repo` or about routing build-heavy cards to cloud.
